hook.name: ReefGuardFeeHook
hook.description: A fixed 5% fee hook for a native ETH / $REEFGUARD pool that always collects fees in ETH regardless of swap direction. In beforeSwap it skims the ETH fee when ETH is the specified currency; in afterSwap it skims from the ETH leg when ETH is unspecified. Fees are forwarded to an immutable feeRecipient address via poolManager.take().
